article: Understanding the mathematical structure of Transformer models
scope: Compared the complete Japanese article and all twelve translations, equations, tensor shapes, causal-mask semantics, architecture claims, complexity statements, code, references, and metadata against the original Transformer paper and current official PyTorch documentation.
findings: Corrected row-vector embedding multiplication and separated key/value dimensions.
Corrected causal-mask inequality so future keys j>i are masked; documented boolean mask semantics.
Qualified parallelism, positional extrapolation, Softmax weight interpretation, and gradient claims.
Clarified encoder-only/decoder-only differences and corrected complexity and FlashAttention limitations.
Replaced incorrect/ambiguous mask pseudocode and unrelated internal links with a shape-documented reference implementation and primary sources.
Preserved the original 2026-09-11 publication date and added lastmod.

post/Transformerモデルの数学的構造を読み解く/index.en..source: post/Transformerモデルの数学的構造を読み解く/index.md
post/Transformerモデルの数学的構造を読み解く/index.en..summary: Compared the complete translation with the Japanese source, original Transformer paper, and current PyTorch references; checked every mathematical statement, tensor dimension, mask direction, code behavior, terminology, metadata, and link.

meaning.note: Compared the complete Japanese source and all twelve translations; corrected architecture scope, embedding shapes, Q/K/V dimensions, scaled scores, causal-mask direction, complexity, FlashAttention claims, and implementation semantics against the original paper and PyTorch docs.

terminology.note: Reviewed encoder/decoder, embedding, positional encoding, query/key/value, head dimensions, FFN, Post-/Pre-LayerNorm, causal mask, and attention complexity in each locale.

mathematics.note: Checked embedding matrix multiplication shapes, sinusoidal position formulas, Q/K/V dimensions, score and output shapes, variance assumption, LayerNorm equations, FFN, and causal-mask inequalities.

code.note: Replaced the ambiguous mask convention with a bool allowed-mask implementation (True means allowed), corrected the future-token triangle, documented broadcast shapes and the all-masked-row constraint, and parsed the shared Python example for syntax. Runtime execution was not possible because PyTorch is not installed in this environment.

links.note: Added the original NeurIPS paper, arXiv paper, and current official PyTorch SDPA and LayerNorm references to all editions.

limitations: AI-assisted review by Codex; no human or native-speaker certification.
The Python example was syntax-checked but not executed because PyTorch is not installed in the environment.
The positional-encoding equations describe the original 2017 architecture; many current models use other position schemes.
Complexity statements describe dense full attention and do not cover every optimized or sparse architecture.
